From: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org>
Date: Thu, 29 Nov 2018 10:55:17 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] Documentation: drm: Remove dangling pointer from drm-mm.rst
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Fixes htmldocs build error:
Error: Cannot open file ../drivers/gpu/drm/drm_global.c

Fixes: 2bb42410b1bd ("drm: Remove drm_global.{c,h} v2")
Cc: Thomas Zimmermann <tzimmermann@suse.de>

Cc: dri-devel@lists.freedesktop.org

Reviewed-by: Christian König <christian.koenig@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Dave Airlie <airlied@redhat.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20181129155522.33749-1-sean@poorly.run

diff --git a/Documentation/gpu/drm-mm.rst b/Documentation/gpu/drm-mm.rst
index d0f3c6b03200..54a696d961a7 100644
--- a/Documentation/gpu/drm-mm.rst
+++ b/Documentation/gpu/drm-mm.rst
@@ -79,9 +79,6 @@ count for the TTM, which will call your initialization function.
 
 See the radeon_ttm.c file for an example of usage.
 
-.. kernel-doc:: drivers/gpu/drm/drm_global.c
-   :export:
-
 
 The Graphics Execution Manager (GEM)
 ====================================
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `Documentation/gpu/drm-mm.rst`**
   - Removed the kernel-doc directive that referenced `drivers/gpu/drm/drm_global.c`. This line was previously included to document the `drm_global.c` file, which has been removed from the codebase.

### Relationships

- The modification in `drm-mm.rst` addresses a documentation issue caused by the removal of the `drm_global.c` file in a previous commit (identified by the hash `2bb42410b1bd`). By removing the reference to this now-nonexistent file, the patch resolves a build error in the documentation process, specifically an error indicating that the file could not be opened. This change ensures that the documentation remains accurate and does not reference outdated or removed components.
